faqs.q: Can you manage marketing across our store and marketplaces together?

faqs.q: Which channel is best for e-commerce?

faqs.q: Do we need consent to email business contacts?

faqs.t: Financial Due Diligence: Knowing Exactly What You Are Buying or Investing In

faqs.q: Can due diligence findings change the deal price?
faqs.a: Often, yes. Findings on earnings quality, debt-like items and working capital frequently lead to price adjustments, warranties or specific conditions.
faqs.t: Financial Due Diligence: Knowing Exactly What You Are Buying or Investing In

faqs.q: Do you review projections?
faqs.a: Yes. We test assumptions against history, pipeline and market data, and model sensitivities.
faqs.t: Financial Due Diligence: Knowing Exactly What You Are Buying or Investing In

faqs.q: What happens if serious issues are found?
faqs.a: Findings may lead to price changes, indemnities, escrow, conditions before completion or, sometimes, a decision not to proceed.
faqs.t: Financial Due Diligence: Knowing Exactly What You Are Buying or Investing In

faqs.q: Do you help after the deal?
faqs.a: Yes. We support integration, reporting improvements and resolving issues identified during due diligence.
faqs.t: Financial Due Diligence: Knowing Exactly What You Are Buying or Investing In

faqs.q: What is financial due diligence?
faqs.a: A structured review of a business’s financial information to confirm earnings, cash flows, working capital, debt and risks before a transaction.
faqs.t: Financial Due Diligence: Knowing Exactly What You Are Buying or Investing In

faqs.q: What is quality of earnings?
faqs.a: Analysis that adjusts reported profit for one-off, non-market and accounting items to show sustainable earnings.
faqs.t: Financial Due Diligence: Knowing Exactly What You Are Buying or Investing In

faqs.q: How long does due diligence take?
faqs.a: Typically three to six weeks, depending on business size, information availability and scope.
faqs.t: Financial Due Diligence: Knowing Exactly What You Are Buying or Investing In

faqs.q: What is a working capital adjustment?
faqs.a: A price adjustment if working capital at completion differs from an agreed normal level, protecting buyers from cash shortfalls.
faqs.t: Financial Due Diligence: Knowing Exactly What You Are Buying or Investing In

faqs.q: What are debt-like items?
faqs.a: Obligations that will consume cash after the deal, such as unpaid taxes, deferred payments, provisions and employee liabilities, often deducted from the price.
faqs.t: Financial Due Diligence: Knowing Exactly What You Are Buying or Investing In

faqs.q: What is vendor due diligence?
faqs.a: Due diligence commissioned by sellers on their own business before a sale, to identify and address issues early.
faqs.t: Financial Due Diligence: Knowing Exactly What You Are Buying or Investing In

faqs.q: Do you review tax and compliance?
faqs.a: Yes. We review income tax, GST, TDS and statutory compliance, highlighting exposures and pending matters.
faqs.t: Financial Due Diligence: Knowing Exactly What You Are Buying or Investing In

faqs.q: Can due diligence reduce the price we pay?
faqs.a: Findings often lead to price adjustments, specific protections or conditions that reflect the actual risks and earnings.
faqs.t: Financial Due Diligence: Knowing Exactly What You Are Buying or Investing In

faqs.q: Do you work with lawyers and other advisers?
faqs.a: Yes. Financial due diligence is coordinated with legal, tax and commercial reviews.
faqs.t: Financial Due Diligence: Knowing Exactly What You Are Buying or Investing In

faqs.q: Is the process confidential?
faqs.a: Yes. All work is conducted under confidentiality agreements with controlled access to information.
faqs.t: Financial Due Diligence: Knowing Exactly What You Are Buying or Investing In

faqs.q: Do you support small investments too?
faqs.a: Yes. Scope can be scaled to the size and risk of the transaction.
faqs.t: Financial Due Diligence: Knowing Exactly What You Are Buying or Investing In

faqs.q: Can you model scenarios for our board?

faqs.q: Can models be built in Google Sheets?
faqs.a: Yes, where collaboration matters more than advanced features; we follow the same structure and checks.

faqs.q: Can you model debt repayments and interest?
faqs.a: Yes. Models include loan drawdowns, repayment schedules, interest and coverage ratios that lenders review.
faqs.t: Financial Modelling: Building Models That Test Your Plans Before You Commit

faqs.q: Do models include charts and dashboards?
faqs.a: Yes. We include summary outputs and charts for presentations to boards, investors and lenders.
faqs.t: Financial Modelling: Building Models That Test Your Plans Before You Commit

faqs.q: What is the FAST standard?
faqs.a: A set of modelling conventions promoting models that are flexible, appropriate, structured and transparent.
faqs.t: Financial Modelling: Building Models That Test Your Plans Before You Commit

faqs.q: Can models include multiple currencies?
faqs.a: Yes. Models can handle multiple currencies with explicit exchange rate assumptions and sensitivity to currency movements.
faqs.t: Financial Modelling: Building Models That Test Your Plans Before You Commit

faqs.q: Can you model the impact of a new product or market?
faqs.a: Yes. We build incremental models showing investment, ramp-up, costs, cash needs and returns for new initiatives.
faqs.t: Financial Modelling: Building Models That Test Your Plans Before You Commit

faqs.q: What is a three-statement financial model?
faqs.a: A model that links projected profit and loss, balance sheet and cash flow so every assumption flows consistently through all three.
faqs.t: Financial Modelling: Building Models That Test Your Plans Before You Commit

faqs.q: Why do investors want a financial model?
faqs.a: To understand how the business grows, how much capital it needs, when it becomes profitable and how sensitive results are to key assumptions.
faqs.t: Financial Modelling: Building Models That Test Your Plans Before You Commit

faqs.q: How long does it take to build a model?
faqs.a: Simple models can be built in one to two weeks; complex operating, project or transaction models may take three to six weeks.

faqs.q: Do you use Excel or specialist software?
faqs.a: Most models are built in Excel or Google Sheets for transparency and ease of use; specialist tools are used where appropriate.

faqs.q: What is sensitivity analysis?
faqs.a: Changing one assumption at a time to see how much it affects results, revealing which drivers matter most.

faqs.q: Can you review a model we already have?
faqs.a: Yes. We review structure, formulas, assumptions and checks, and suggest corrections and improvements.

faqs.q: What information do you need?
faqs.a: Historical financials, current management accounts, business plans, key operational data and your views on growth and costs.

faqs.q: Can the model be used for budgeting later?
faqs.a: Yes. Well-built models can be adapted for annual budgets and rolling forecasts.
faqs.t: Financial Modelling: Building Models That Test Your Plans Before You Commit

faqs.q: Do you build models for bank loans?
faqs.a: Yes, including debt service coverage analysis and the outputs lenders typically request.

faqs.q: Will our team be able to update the model?

faqs.q: What is the GST registration threshold in India?
faqs.a: Broadly ₹40 lakh aggregate turnover for suppliers of goods and ₹20 lakh for suppliers of services, with lower limits in some special category states. Some businesses must register regardless of turnover. Always confirm the current rules for your state and supply type.
faqs.t: GST Compliance Made Simple: Registration, Returns, Input Tax Credit and Avoiding Notices

faqs.q: What is the difference between GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B?
faqs.a: GSTR-1 reports your sales invoice by invoice. GSTR-3B is a summary return in which you report totals, claim input tax credit and pay the tax due. The two should agree for each period.
faqs.t: GST Compliance Made Simple: Registration, Returns, Input Tax Credit and Avoiding Notices

faqs.q: Why is my input tax credit lower than my purchase records?
faqs.a: Usually because some suppliers have not reported your invoices, or reported them with errors. Reconciling your purchases with GSTR-2B each month and following up with suppliers helps recover that credit.
faqs.t: GST Compliance Made Simple: Registration, Returns, Input Tax Credit and Avoiding Notices

faqs.q: What should I do if I receive a GST notice?
faqs.a: Read it carefully, note the deadline, reconcile the figures for the period, gather supporting documents and reply clearly through the GST portal. Professional support is worthwhile, especially if amounts are significant.
faqs.t: GST Compliance Made Simple: Registration, Returns, Input Tax Credit and Avoiding Notices

faqs.q: Can you handle GST along with accounting and TDS?
faqs.a: Yes. Many clients combine GST with bookkeeping, TDS, payroll and MIS reporting, so the same team keeps every return consistent with the books.
faqs.t: GST Compliance Made Simple: Registration, Returns, Input Tax Credit and Avoiding Notices

faqs.q: How do you verify that respondents are real doctors?
faqs.a: We check registration details against official medical registers where available, confirm practice and contact information, telephone-verify a share of members and monitor consistency over time. Members who fail checks are removed.

faqs.q: Can you reach rare specialists?

faqs.t: Healthcare Market Research Panels: Reaching Doctors, Patients and Caregivers the Right Way

faqs.q: How are adverse events handled during research?
faqs.a: Teams are trained to recognise adverse events, product complaints and special situations. These are reported to the client’s pharmacovigilance team within the agreed timeframe, and respondents are informed of this in advance.

faqs.q: Do you include patients and caregivers?

faqs.q: How long does a healthcare survey take to complete?

faqs.q: Can I revise my return if I made a mistake?
faqs.a: Generally yes. A revised return can be filed within the time allowed to correct errors or omissions, and an updated return may be used to report additional income within its own time limits.
faqs.t: Income Tax Return (ITR) Filing in India: A Clear Guide for Individuals, Professionals and Businesses

faqs.q: Which ITR form should I file?
faqs.a: It depends on your residential status and income types. Simple salary income usually uses ITR-1 within its limits; capital gains need ITR-2; business or professional income needs ITR-3, or ITR-4 under presumptive taxation. Check the current year’s eligibility on the portal.
faqs.t: Income Tax Return (ITR) Filing in India: A Clear Guide for Individuals, Professionals and Businesses

faqs.q: Should I choose the old or new tax regime?
faqs.a: Calculate tax under both using your actual income and deductions. The new regime suits people with few deductions; the old regime can be better for those with large eligible deductions.
faqs.t: Income Tax Return (ITR) Filing in India: A Clear Guide for Individuals, Professionals and Businesses

faqs.q: What happens if I miss the ITR due date?
faqs.a: You can generally file a belated return within the time allowed, usually with a late fee and loss of some benefits such as carrying forward certain losses. Interest may also apply on unpaid tax.
faqs.t: Income Tax Return (ITR) Filing in India: A Clear Guide for Individuals, Professionals and Businesses

faqs.q: Why does AIS matter?
faqs.a: AIS shows income and transactions reported to the department. Reconciling your return with AIS and Form 26AS before filing helps avoid mismatches and notices.
faqs.t: Income Tax Return (ITR) Filing in India: A Clear Guide for Individuals, Professionals and Businesses

faqs.q: Do professionals and freelancers need to pay advance tax?
faqs.a: Generally yes, if their estimated tax after TDS is ₹10,000 or more. Missing instalments leads to interest.
faqs.t: Income Tax Return (ITR) Filing in India: A Clear Guide for Individuals, Professionals and Businesses

faqs.q: Can you reply to an income tax notice for me?
faqs.a: Yes. We review the notice, reconcile figures, prepare documentation and respond through the portal, working with your chartered accountant where required.
faqs.t: Income Tax Return (ITR) Filing in India: A Clear Guide for Individuals, Professionals and Businesses

faqs.q: Can influencer content help SEO?

faqs.q: Are micro influencers better than big influencers?

faqs.q: Do influencers need to disclose paid partnerships in India?

faqs.q: How much does influencer marketing cost?

faqs.q: How can we avoid emotional investment decisions?

faqs.q: Should we stagger investment maturities?

faqs.q: Do loan covenants affect how we invest surplus cash?

faqs.t: Investment Planning for Businesses and Owners: Putting Surplus Funds to Work Sensibly

faqs.q: How much cash should a business keep before investing?
faqs.a: Enough for day-to-day needs plus a reserve covering several months of fixed costs and known commitments, based on a cash flow forecast.
faqs.t: Investment Planning for Businesses and Owners: Putting Surplus Funds to Work Sensibly

faqs.q: What is a corporate investment policy?
faqs.a: A board- or owner-approved document defining investment objectives, permitted instruments, risk and exposure limits, approvals and reporting.

faqs.q: Do you give personal investment advice?

faqs.q: Where should short-term business surplus be invested?
faqs.a: Typically in highly liquid, low-risk options aligned with your policy, so funds remain available when needed.
faqs.t: Investment Planning for Businesses and Owners: Putting Surplus Funds to Work Sensibly

faqs.q: Why does liquidity matter so much?

faqs.q: How are business investments taxed?

faqs.q: Should business owners invest outside their company?

faqs.q: How often should investments be reviewed?

faqs.q: Can you prepare investment reports for our board?

faqs.q: What is goal-based investment planning?
faqs.a: Linking each pool of money to a specific goal, amount and date, so time horizon and risk capacity guide how it is invested.

faqs.a: Yes, including consolidated reports with inter-company eliminations alongside entity and segment views.
faqs.t: MIS and Financial Reporting: Monthly Numbers That Tell You What to Do Next

faqs.q: What is an MIS report?
faqs.a: A regular management report combining financial and operational numbers with commentary, designed to help leaders understand performance and make decisions.
faqs.t: MIS and Financial Reporting: Monthly Numbers That Tell You What to Do Next

faqs.q: What should a monthly MIS include?
faqs.a: Typically a summary, P&L against budget, profitability by segment, overheads, cash and forecast, receivables and payables, key KPIs and commentary.
faqs.t: MIS and Financial Reporting: Monthly Numbers That Tell You What to Do Next

faqs.q: How soon after month end should MIS be ready?
faqs.a: Ideally within one to two weeks, which requires a disciplined month-end close and standard templates.
faqs.t: MIS and Financial Reporting: Monthly Numbers That Tell You What to Do Next

faqs.q: How many KPIs should we track?
faqs.a: Usually five to ten that reflect what drives value in your business, each with a clear definition, target and owner.
faqs.t: MIS and Financial Reporting: Monthly Numbers That Tell You What to Do Next

faqs.q: Can MIS be automated?
faqs.a: Yes. Data extraction, report building and dashboards can be automated from accounting, CRM and operational systems.
faqs.t: MIS and Financial Reporting: Monthly Numbers That Tell You What to Do Next

faqs.q: What is the difference between MIS and financial statements?
faqs.a: MIS is flexible management reporting for decisions; financial statements follow prescribed formats for compliance and external stakeholders.
faqs.t: MIS and Financial Reporting: Monthly Numbers That Tell You What to Do Next

faqs.q: Do you prepare board and investor reports?
faqs.a: Yes. We prepare concise, consistent board packs covering performance, KPIs, cash, risks and progress against plan.
faqs.t: MIS and Financial Reporting: Monthly Numbers That Tell You What to Do Next

faqs.q: Can you show profitability by product or branch?
faqs.a: Yes, by structuring accounts with cost centres or tags and applying a sensible allocation of shared costs.
faqs.t: MIS and Financial Reporting: Monthly Numbers That Tell You What to Do Next

faqs.q: Do you explain the numbers to management?
faqs.a: Yes. Monthly reviews walk through results, variances and recommended actions.
faqs.t: MIS and Financial Reporting: Monthly Numbers That Tell You What to Do Next

faqs.q: Can you improve or take over an existing app?
faqs.a: Yes. We start with a code and architecture review, fix critical issues and security gaps, update libraries and OS support, and then plan improvements. If the codebase is not maintainable, we explain the options honestly, including a phased rebuild.
faqs.t: Mobile App Development: From Product Idea to Launch

faqs.q: How long does it take to build a mobile app?
faqs.a: A focused MVP typically takes eight to twelve weeks including design, development, testing and store submission. Larger apps are delivered in phases over several months.
faqs.t: Mobile App Development: From Product Idea to Launch

faqs.q: Should I build for Android or iOS first?
faqs.a: In India, Android has the larger user base, but many business audiences use iPhones. Cross-platform development lets you launch on both at once for a similar cost to one native app.
faqs.t: Mobile App Development: From Product Idea to Launch

faqs.q: Can the app work offline?
faqs.a: Yes. We design offline-first apps that store data securely on the device and synchronise when connectivity returns, which is essential for field and rural use.
faqs.t: Mobile App Development: From Product Idea to Launch

faqs.q: Will you publish the app to the App Store and Google Play?
faqs.a: Yes. We prepare store listings, privacy disclosures and submissions, and handle any review feedback. The store accounts are in your name.
faqs.t: Mobile App Development: From Product Idea to Launch

faqs.q: Do you maintain the app after launch?
faqs.a: Yes. Maintenance plans cover monitoring, bug fixes, OS and device updates, security patches and new features.
faqs.t: Mobile App Development: From Product Idea to Launch

faqs.q: Do interviewers speak local languages?
faqs.a: Yes. We recruit interviewers locally wherever possible, so they speak the respondent’s language and understand local context.
faqs.t: Offline Data Collection: CATI, CAPI and Face-to-Face Fieldwork That Reaches Everyone

faqs.q: Can you combine offline and online interviews in one study?
faqs.a: Yes. Mixed-mode designs adapt the questionnaire for each mode and weight the combined data, giving both reach and speed.
faqs.t: Offline Data Collection: CATI, CAPI and Face-to-Face Fieldwork That Reaches Everyone

faqs.q: What share of interviews do you back-check?
faqs.a: It depends on the study and client requirements, commonly around 10% or more, performed by a team independent of the interviewers, with results reported in the field report.
faqs.t: Offline Data Collection: CATI, CAPI and Face-to-Face Fieldwork That Reaches Everyone

faqs.q: Can respondents answer sensitive questions privately in face-to-face interviews?
faqs.a: Yes. Sensitive sections can be self-completed on the device, so respondents enter answers privately while the interviewer waits.
faqs.t: Offline Data Collection: CATI, CAPI and Face-to-Face Fieldwork That Reaches Everyone

faqs.q: What is CATI?
faqs.a: Computer-assisted telephone interviewing: trained interviewers call respondents and record answers in a scripted questionnaire, with live supervision and quota control.
faqs.t: Offline Data Collection: CATI, CAPI and Face-to-Face Fieldwork That Reaches Everyone

faqs.q: What is CAPI?
faqs.a: Computer-assisted personal interviewing: face-to-face interviews conducted on tablets or phones, often with GPS and time stamps, used for household, rural and intercept research.
faqs.t: Offline Data Collection: CATI, CAPI and Face-to-Face Fieldwork That Reaches Everyone

faqs.q: When should I use offline instead of online research?
faqs.a: When your audience includes people who are not reliably online, such as rural, older or low-literacy groups, or when products must be shown or tested in person.
faqs.t: Offline Data Collection: CATI, CAPI and Face-to-Face Fieldwork That Reaches Everyone

faqs.q: How do you check that interviews really happened?
faqs.a: Through supervision, back-checks by an independent team, GPS and time stamps, duration and pattern checks, and recordings where legally permitted and consented.
faqs.t: Offline Data Collection: CATI, CAPI and Face-to-Face Fieldwork That Reaches Everyone

faqs.q: Which languages can you cover?
faqs.a: Hindi and major regional languages, with local interviewers and translated, back-checked questionnaires.
faqs.t: Offline Data Collection: CATI, CAPI and Face-to-Face Fieldwork That Reaches Everyone

faqs.q: Can you run central location tests?
faqs.a: Yes. We recruit respondents, manage venues and stimuli, and run product tests, tastings and evaluations in person.
faqs.t: Offline Data Collection: CATI, CAPI and Face-to-Face Fieldwork That Reaches Everyone

faqs.q: How long does offline fieldwork take?
faqs.a: CATI studies can complete in one to three weeks. Face-to-face and household surveys typically take three to eight weeks depending on geography and sample size.
faqs.t: Offline Data Collection: CATI, CAPI and Face-to-Face Fieldwork That Reaches Everyone

faqs.q: Do you provide a field report?
faqs.a: Yes. It documents sampling, response, interviewer performance, back-check results, removals and any substitutions.
faqs.t: Offline Data Collection: CATI, CAPI and Face-to-Face Fieldwork That Reaches Everyone

faqs.q: What is online data collection?
faqs.a: It is collecting research responses over the internet, usually through online surveys completed on a phone or computer. Respondents typically come from research panels, customer lists or targeted online recruitment.
faqs.t: Online Surveys and Online Data Collection: How to Get Fast Research Data You Can Actually Trust

faqs.q: How fast can an online survey be completed?
faqs.a: For common consumer audiences, fieldwork can finish in a few days. Niche B2B or healthcare audiences, or multi-country studies, usually take one to three weeks. We confirm timelines after checking feasibility.
faqs.t: Online Surveys and Online Data Collection: How to Get Fast Research Data You Can Actually Trust

faqs.q: How do you stop fake or low-quality survey responses?
faqs.a: We use verified panels, device and location checks, attention and consistency checks, removal of speeders and straight-liners, and manual review of open-ended answers. Removed responses are replaced during fieldwork.
faqs.t: Online Surveys and Online Data Collection: How to Get Fast Research Data You Can Actually Trust

faqs.q: Can online surveys reach doctors and business decision-makers?
faqs.a: Yes, through verified professional panels. Our healthcare panel verifies healthcare professionals, and our business panel profiles members by role, seniority, industry and company size.
faqs.t: Online Surveys and Online Data Collection: How to Get Fast Research Data You Can Actually Trust

faqs.q: What sample size do I need for an online survey?
faqs.a: About 385 completes gives a ±5% margin at 95% confidence for a simple estimate, but you also need enough responses in each subgroup you want to report. We help set sample sizes based on your objectives.
faqs.t: Online Surveys and Online Data Collection: How to Get Fast Research Data You Can Actually Trust

faqs.q: Do you train staff to respond to reviews?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide response guidelines, templates and training so teams reply consistently and appropriately.
faqs.t: Online Reputation Management: Protecting and Building Trust Where Customers Look

faqs.q: Can you set up review requests automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Review requests can be triggered by email or WhatsApp after deliveries or appointments, with clear timing and links.
faqs.t: Online Reputation Management: Protecting and Building Trust Where Customers Look

faqs.q: Do you help with app store reviews?
faqs.a: Yes. We monitor and respond to app reviews and help address recurring issues that affect ratings.
faqs.t: Online Reputation Management: Protecting and Building Trust Where Customers Look

faqs.q: Can you help with negative news articles?
faqs.a: We help correct factual errors with publishers, prepare responses and build accurate positive content; we do not use deceptive tactics.
faqs.t: Online Reputation Management: Protecting and Building Trust Where Customers Look

faqs.q: How do you measure reputation improvement?
faqs.a: Through ratings, review volume, response rates, sentiment, search results and enquiry conversion from profiles.
faqs.t: Online Reputation Management: Protecting and Building Trust Where Customers Look

faqs.q: Can we ask customers for reviews on WhatsApp?
faqs.a: Yes, with opted-in customers and polite, well-timed messages, following platform rules about review requests.
faqs.t: Online Reputation Management: Protecting and Building Trust Where Customers Look

faqs.q: Should we respond to every review?
faqs.a: Responding to all reviews, or at least all negative and detailed ones, shows customers you listen and care.
faqs.t: Online Reputation Management: Protecting and Building Trust Where Customers Look

faqs.q: Do you manage reputation for multiple locations?
faqs.a: Yes. We manage listings, review generation, responses and reporting for each location.
faqs.t: Online Reputation Management: Protecting and Building Trust Where Customers Look

faqs.q: What is online reputation management?
faqs.a: Monitoring, protecting and strengthening how a business appears online, especially in reviews, search results and social media.
faqs.t: Online Reputation Management: Protecting and Building Trust Where Customers Look

faqs.q: How can we get more Google reviews?
faqs.a: Deliver good experiences, ask at the right moment with a direct link, follow up once and make it easy. Never buy or fake reviews.
faqs.t: Online Reputation Management: Protecting and Building Trust Where Customers Look

faqs.q: Can negative reviews be removed?
faqs.a: Only if they violate platform policies or laws, such as fake or abusive content. Legitimate criticism should be addressed with a helpful response and real improvements.
faqs.t: Online Reputation Management: Protecting and Building Trust Where Customers Look

faqs.q: How should we respond to a negative review?
faqs.a: Promptly and calmly: acknowledge, apologise where appropriate, avoid arguing, and offer to resolve the issue offline with a named contact.
faqs.t: Online Reputation Management: Protecting and Building Trust Where Customers Look

faqs.q: Can you push down negative search results?
faqs.a: We help build accurate, valuable content and profiles that rank for your brand. We do not use deceptive tactics to hide legitimate criticism.
faqs.t: Online Reputation Management: Protecting and Building Trust Where Customers Look

faqs.q: Do you monitor social media mentions?
faqs.a: Yes. We set up monitoring and social listening to track mentions, sentiment and emerging issues.
faqs.t: Online Reputation Management: Protecting and Building Trust Where Customers Look

faqs.q: Do you help with employer reviews?
faqs.a: Yes. We help encourage honest employee reviews, respond professionally and strengthen employer branding.
faqs.t: Online Reputation Management: Protecting and Building Trust Where Customers Look

faqs.q: What should we do in a reputation crisis?
faqs.a: Respond quickly with facts and empathy, explain actions being taken, update regularly and coordinate with legal and regulatory requirements.
faqs.t: Online Reputation Management: Protecting and Building Trust Where Customers Look

faqs.q: How long does it take to improve reputation?
faqs.a: Responses and profile fixes have immediate effect; building review volume and changing search results usually take three to six months.
faqs.t: Online Reputation Management: Protecting and Building Trust Where Customers Look

faqs.q: Is online reputation management ethical?
faqs.a: It should be. Ethical ORM focuses on genuine reviews, honest responses, accurate information and fixing real problems.
faqs.t: Online Reputation Management: Protecting and Building Trust Where Customers Look

faqs.q: How do you handle employees choosing different tax regimes?
faqs.a: We record each employee’s choice, calculate TDS accordingly, and help explain the implications so employees can choose with confidence.
faqs.t: Payroll in India Made Simple: Salaries, PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS and Compliance

faqs.q: Can payroll integrate with our attendance system?
faqs.a: Yes. We integrate attendance and leave data so payroll inputs flow automatically and accurately each month.
faqs.t: Payroll in India Made Simple: Salaries, PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS and Compliance

faqs.q: Is PF registration mandatory for my company?
faqs.a: Generally, establishments covered under the EPF law, commonly those with 20 or more employees, must register. Smaller establishments may register voluntarily. Confirm current thresholds with EPFO or an adviser.
faqs.t: Payroll in India Made Simple: Salaries, PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS and Compliance

faqs.q: Who is covered by ESI?
faqs.a: Employees earning up to the notified wage limit in establishments covered by the ESI scheme. Coverage depends on wages and location, so payroll must track eligibility.
faqs.t: Payroll in India Made Simple: Salaries, PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS and Compliance

faqs.q: When are PF, ESI and TDS due?
faqs.a: PF and ESI contributions are typically due by the 15th of the following month, and TDS deposits by the 7th, with returns on their own schedules. Always check current due dates.
faqs.t: Payroll in India Made Simple: Salaries, PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS and Compliance

faqs.q: What is a full and final settlement?
faqs.a: The final calculation for a departing employee, covering pending salary, leave encashment, bonuses, gratuity where eligible, recoveries and tax, paid within a reasonable time after exit.
faqs.t: Payroll in India Made Simple: Salaries, PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS and Compliance

faqs.q: Can you run payroll for employees in several states?
faqs.a: Yes. We manage state-specific professional tax and labour welfare fund rules alongside PF, ESI and TDS, with a compliance calendar for each state.
faqs.t: Payroll in India Made Simple: Salaries, PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS and Compliance

faqs.q: Is our payroll data kept confidential?
faqs.a: Yes. Access is restricted to the assigned team, data is stored and transferred securely, and confidentiality agreements apply.
faqs.t: Payroll in India Made Simple: Salaries, PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS and Compliance

faqs.q: Do you issue Form 16 and handle TDS returns?
faqs.a: Yes. We calculate TDS monthly, file quarterly returns and issue Form 16 to employees at year end.
faqs.t: Payroll in India Made Simple: Salaries, PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS and Compliance

faqs.q: Can you work alongside our in-house team?
faqs.a: Yes. We can run campaigns fully or support your team with strategy, tracking, creative testing and reporting.
faqs.t: Performance Marketing: From Marketing Spend to Measurable Growth

faqs.q: Do you report weekly or monthly?
faqs.a: Both: weekly operational updates on spend and results, and a monthly business review connecting marketing to revenue, profit and next steps.
faqs.t: Performance Marketing: From Marketing Spend to Measurable Growth

faqs.q: What is incrementality testing?
faqs.a: Experiments, such as holdout groups or geographic tests, that estimate how many conversions advertising truly added beyond those that would have happened anyway.
faqs.t: Performance Marketing: From Marketing Spend to Measurable Growth

faqs.q: How often should creative be refreshed?
faqs.a: It depends on spend and audience size. We monitor frequency and performance trends and introduce new concepts before results decline.
faqs.t: Performance Marketing: From Marketing Spend to Measurable Growth

faqs.q: How much budget should we test with?
faqs.a: Enough to generate meaningful conversion data within a few weeks. We recommend a starting budget based on expected costs per conversion and the number of results needed to judge performance.
faqs.t: Performance Marketing: From Marketing Spend to Measurable Growth

faqs.q: What is performance marketing?
faqs.a: Advertising where spend is tied to measurable outcomes such as leads, sales or installs, with budgets continually moved towards what delivers the best results.
faqs.t: Performance Marketing: From Marketing Spend to Measurable Growth

faqs.q: What is a good ROAS?
faqs.a: It depends on your margins and customer lifetime value. A ROAS that is profitable for a high-margin product may lose money for a low-margin one, so targets should come from unit economics.
faqs.t: Performance Marketing: From Marketing Spend to Measurable Growth

faqs.q: Which channels should we start with?
faqs.a: Usually the channel closest to purchase intent, such as Google Search, then demand-creation channels like Meta or LinkedIn once tracking and conversion basics work.
faqs.t: Performance Marketing: From Marketing Spend to Measurable Growth

faqs.q: Why do platform results differ from our sales data?
faqs.a: Each platform uses its own attribution and may claim conversions also influenced by other channels. Cross-checking with GA4, CRM and blended metrics gives a truer picture.
faqs.t: Performance Marketing: From Marketing Spend to Measurable Growth

faqs.q: How quickly can we scale ad spend?
faqs.a: Gradually. Increasing budgets in steps while watching marginal returns avoids sharp rises in acquisition cost.
faqs.t: Performance Marketing: From Marketing Spend to Measurable Growth

faqs.q: Do you create ad creative?
faqs.a: Yes. We produce and test concepts across formats, using audience insight to shape hooks and messages, and refresh creative before fatigue sets in.
faqs.t: Performance Marketing: From Marketing Spend to Measurable Growth

faqs.q: Can performance marketing work for B2B?
faqs.a: Yes, when optimised for qualified leads and pipeline rather than form fills, with CRM outcomes fed back to the platforms.
faqs.t: Performance Marketing: From Marketing Spend to Measurable Growth

faqs.q: Do we keep ownership of ad accounts?
faqs.a: Yes. Accounts, pixels, data and creative belong to you; we work through partner or manager access.
faqs.t: Performance Marketing: From Marketing Spend to Measurable Growth

faqs.q: What deliverables do I receive from a qualitative study?
faqs.a: Typically recordings, transcripts or summaries, and a findings report with implications, illustrated with quotes and, where agreed, short video highlights. Many clients also choose a debrief workshop with their team.
faqs.t: Qualitative Research Explained: In-Depth Interviews, Focus Groups and Finding the “Why”

faqs.q: How many interviews or focus groups do I need?
faqs.a: It depends on how many distinct audience types you need to understand. Often 12–30 in-depth interviews or four to eight focus groups, with enough per segment to see consistent patterns.
faqs.t: Qualitative Research Explained: In-Depth Interviews, Focus Groups and Finding the “Why”

faqs.q: Can qualitative research be done online?
faqs.a: Yes. Video interviews, online focus groups and online communities work well for many audiences, especially professionals and geographically spread participants.
faqs.t: Qualitative Research Explained: In-Depth Interviews, Focus Groups and Finding the “Why”

faqs.q: Do you conduct research in regional languages?
faqs.a: Yes. Sessions are run in the language participants are most comfortable with, by moderators who understand local context, with transcripts and translations provided.
faqs.t: Qualitative Research Explained: In-Depth Interviews, Focus Groups and Finding the “Why”

faqs.q: Can I watch the sessions?
faqs.a: Yes. Clients can observe online sessions live or watch recordings, and in-person groups can be viewed from an observation room or by live stream, with participant consent.
faqs.t: Qualitative Research Explained: In-Depth Interviews, Focus Groups and Finding the “Why”

faqs.q: How long does a qualitative study take?
faqs.a: Typically three to five weeks, including recruitment, fieldwork, analysis and reporting. Smaller interview programmes can be faster.
faqs.t: Qualitative Research Explained: In-Depth Interviews, Focus Groups and Finding the “Why”

faqs.q: Is qualitative research statistically reliable?
faqs.a: It is not designed to be statistically representative. It shows the range of views and the reasons behind them; a quantitative survey can then measure how common each view is.
faqs.t: Qualitative Research Explained: In-Depth Interviews, Focus Groups and Finding the “Why”

faqs.q: Can surveys include images, videos or product concepts?
faqs.a: Yes. Online and CAPI surveys can show images, videos and interactive stimuli; telephone surveys rely on clear verbal descriptions instead.
faqs.t: Quantitative Research: Measuring What Matters with Surveys You Can Rely On

faqs.q: How long does a quantitative study take?
faqs.a: Simple online studies can take two to three weeks from questionnaire to report. Multi-country, mixed-mode or advanced analytics studies usually take four to eight weeks.
faqs.t: Quantitative Research: Measuring What Matters with Surveys You Can Rely On

faqs.q: Can you weight results to match the population?
faqs.a: Yes. We weight to reliable population profiles where appropriate, keep weights modest and document the approach so results can be interpreted properly.
faqs.t: Quantitative Research: Measuring What Matters with Surveys You Can Rely On

faqs.q: What is quantitative research?
faqs.a: Research that measures opinions and behaviour numerically, using structured questionnaires answered by enough people to allow statistical analysis and comparison.
faqs.t: Quantitative Research: Measuring What Matters with Surveys You Can Rely On

faqs.q: How many respondents do I need?
faqs.a: It depends on precision and subgroups. Around 385 gives about ±5% at 95% confidence for a simple estimate, but each subgroup you analyse needs an adequate base too.
faqs.t: Quantitative Research: Measuring What Matters with Surveys You Can Rely On

faqs.q: Should I use online, telephone or face-to-face interviews?
faqs.a: Online suits connected audiences and speed; telephone reaches people without internet; face-to-face gives the widest coverage. Mixed mode combines them when needed.
faqs.t: Quantitative Research: Measuring What Matters with Surveys You Can Rely On

faqs.q: What is conjoint analysis?
faqs.a: A method that shows respondents realistic product options with different features and prices, revealing how they trade off attributes and what they are willing to pay.
faqs.t: Quantitative Research: Measuring What Matters with Surveys You Can Rely On

faqs.q: What does statistical significance mean?
faqs.a: That a difference between groups is unlikely to be due to chance. It does not mean the difference is large or important, which must be judged separately.
faqs.t: Quantitative Research: Measuring What Matters with Surveys You Can Rely On

faqs.q: Can you run trackers over several years?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep questions, sample definitions and quotas consistent across waves and provide dashboards that update as each wave completes.
faqs.t: Quantitative Research: Measuring What Matters with Surveys You Can Rely On

faqs.q: Do you provide raw data?
faqs.a: Yes. Clean, weighted datasets in SPSS, Excel or CSV with a codebook and documentation of cleaning and weighting decisions.
faqs.t: Quantitative Research: Measuring What Matters with Surveys You Can Rely On

faqs.q: Do you sign confidentiality agreements?
faqs.a: Yes. Consultancy work often involves strategic plans and sensitive data, so confidentiality agreements are standard and access is limited to the project team.
faqs.t: Research Consultancy: How Expert Guidance Turns Business Questions into the Right Research

faqs.q: Can you work with our internal insights team?
faqs.a: Yes. We often support internal teams with study design, specialist methods, fieldwork capacity or independent analysis, working within your existing processes.
faqs.t: Research Consultancy: How Expert Guidance Turns Business Questions into the Right Research

faqs.q: What does a research consultant do?
faqs.a: Helps define the business decision, turns it into research questions, recommends the most efficient methods, oversees fieldwork and analysis, and translates findings into practical recommendations.
faqs.t: Research Consultancy: How Expert Guidance Turns Business Questions into the Right Research

faqs.q: How is research consultancy different from fieldwork?
faqs.a: Fieldwork collects data. Consultancy decides what data is needed, how to collect it and what it means for the business. We offer both, separately or together.
faqs.t: Research Consultancy: How Expert Guidance Turns Business Questions into the Right Research

faqs.q: Can you size a market without a large survey?
faqs.a: Often, yes. Secondary data, expert interviews and transparent bottom-up modelling can produce a credible estimate, with a survey added only where key assumptions need validation.
faqs.t: Research Consultancy: How Expert Guidance Turns Business Questions into the Right Research

faqs.q: Do you work with research agencies and consultancies?
faqs.a: Yes. Many clients are agencies and consultancies who use us for study design, feasibility, fieldwork, panels and data processing, often on a white-label basis.
faqs.t: Research Consultancy: How Expert Guidance Turns Business Questions into the Right Research

faqs.q: How long does a consultancy project take?
faqs.a: Focused projects using existing data and interviews can take two to four weeks. Programmes with qualitative and quantitative phases typically take six to ten weeks.
faqs.t: Research Consultancy: How Expert Guidance Turns Business Questions into the Right Research

faqs.q: Is competitive intelligence legal and ethical?
faqs.a: When done properly, yes. It relies on public and legitimately obtained information and never involves misrepresentation or confidential information obtained improperly.
faqs.t: Research Consultancy: How Expert Guidance Turns Business Questions into the Right Research

faqs.q: What will we receive at the end?
faqs.a: A clear answer to the decision, supporting evidence, models or data where relevant, recommendations with risks and assumptions, and usually a workshop with your team.
faqs.t: Research Consultancy: How Expert Guidance Turns Business Questions into the Right Research

faqs.q: Can the cycle be shortened for urgent decisions?
faqs.a: Yes. Stages can run faster with focused objectives, existing panels and standard templates, but steps such as a brief check, a short pilot and quality review should never be skipped.
faqs.t: The Research Design Cycle: Seven Steps from Business Question to Actionable Insight

faqs.q: Who should attend the research briefing?
faqs.a: Ideally the decision-maker, the people who will use the findings and anyone with relevant existing data or context, so objectives reflect real needs.
faqs.t: The Research Design Cycle: Seven Steps from Business Question to Actionable Insight

faqs.q: What is the research design cycle?
faqs.a: A structured, seven-stage process for research: Understand, Design, Sample, Collect, Process, Analyse and Deliver insights, with quality checks at each stage.
faqs.t: The Research Design Cycle: Seven Steps from Business Question to Actionable Insight

faqs.q: Why write an analysis plan before the questionnaire?
faqs.a: It ensures every question serves an objective and that the data will support the comparisons and techniques you need, avoiding gaps discovered after fieldwork.
faqs.t: The Research Design Cycle: Seven Steps from Business Question to Actionable Insight

faqs.q: How do I choose between qualitative and quantitative research?
faqs.a: Use qualitative to explore and understand why, and quantitative to measure how many or how much. Many studies combine both.
faqs.t: The Research Design Cycle: Seven Steps from Business Question to Actionable Insight

faqs.q: What is a pilot or soft launch?
faqs.a: A small first round of fieldwork that tests timing, understanding and routing before the full study, so issues can be fixed early.
faqs.t: The Research Design Cycle: Seven Steps from Business Question to Actionable Insight

faqs.q: Can you design research that our team will run?
faqs.a: Yes. We can provide study design, questionnaires, sampling plans and analysis plans for your team or another supplier to execute.
faqs.t: The Research Design Cycle: Seven Steps from Business Question to Actionable Insight

faqs.q: How long does a typical study take?
faqs.a: Two to four weeks for focused online studies; six to twelve weeks for multi-phase, multi-country or offline studies.
faqs.t: The Research Design Cycle: Seven Steps from Business Question to Actionable Insight

faqs.q: What does ISO 20252 certification mean?
faqs.a: It is an international standard for market, opinion and social research that sets requirements for processes and quality across the research cycle.
faqs.t: The Research Design Cycle: Seven Steps from Business Question to Actionable Insight

faqs.q: What deliverables can we expect?
faqs.a: Depending on the study: reports, executive summaries, dashboards, data files, qualitative highlights and stakeholder workshops.
faqs.t: The Research Design Cycle: Seven Steps from Business Question to Actionable Insight

faqs.q: Do you review existing questionnaires?
faqs.a: Yes. We review drafts for clarity, bias, routing and analysis potential before fieldwork.
faqs.t: The Research Design Cycle: Seven Steps from Business Question to Actionable Insight

faqs.q: Can you train our team to write better research reports?
faqs.a: Yes. We run practical sessions on structuring reports around decisions, writing action titles and designing clear charts.
faqs.t: Research Reporting and Insights: Turning Data into Decisions People Act On

faqs.q: Can you provide reports in our own templates?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver white-label reports, charts and dashboards in your templates and style for presenting to your own clients.
faqs.t: Research Reporting and Insights: Turning Data into Decisions People Act On

faqs.q: Do you include video highlights from interviews?
faqs.a: Yes, where participants have consented, short highlight reels bring customers’ voices into presentations and workshops.
faqs.t: Research Reporting and Insights: Turning Data into Decisions People Act On

faqs.q: Can you boost small groups for analysis?

faqs.q: How do you avoid professional respondents?

faqs.q: What is a feasibility check?
faqs.a: An assessment of whether the required number of qualifying respondents can be reached within the timeline and budget, based on real panel counts, incidence and response rates.

faqs.q: What is incidence in market research?
faqs.a: The share of people contacted who qualify for a study. Low incidence means more screening is needed, which increases cost and fieldwork time.

faqs.q: What is the difference between quotas and weighting?
faqs.a: Quotas control who is recruited during fieldwork; weighting adjusts the data afterwards so the sample matches the population on key characteristics.

faqs.q: Can you reach rural and offline audiences?

faqs.q: How do you stop the wrong people qualifying?

faqs.q: Do you provide sample only, without the full study?

faqs.q: How does the new Income-tax Act affect planning?
faqs.a: It restructures the law from 1 April 2026, changing section numbers and some provisions. Positions should be reviewed against the current law each year.
faqs.t: Tax Planning and Advisory: Staying Compliant While Making Tax-Efficient Decisions

faqs.q: Do you advise on GST as well as income tax?
faqs.a: Yes. We advise on GST structure, classification, input credit, place of supply and compliance alongside direct tax.
faqs.t: Tax Planning and Advisory: Staying Compliant While Making Tax-Efficient Decisions

faqs.q: Can you help with tax notices?
faqs.a: Yes. We help prepare responses and documentation, working with your chartered accountant or counsel where needed.
faqs.t: Tax Planning and Advisory: Staying Compliant While Making Tax-Efficient Decisions

faqs.q: Do you advise on related-party and international transactions?
faqs.a: Yes, including documentation of arm’s-length terms, withholding on foreign payments and coordination with transfer pricing specialists where required.
faqs.t: Tax Planning and Advisory: Staying Compliant While Making Tax-Efficient Decisions

faqs.q: How often should we review our tax position?
faqs.a: At least annually, and whenever there is a significant change in the business, the law or personal circumstances.
faqs.t: Tax Planning and Advisory: Staying Compliant While Making Tax-Efficient Decisions

faqs.q: Do you issue Form 16 and Form 16A?
faqs.a: Yes. We generate certificates through TRACES after returns are processed and share them with employees and vendors on time.
faqs.t: TDS Compliance for Businesses: Deduction, Deposit, Returns and Certificates Without the Stress

faqs.q: Do we need a separate TAN for each branch?
faqs.a: Businesses may obtain TAN for each branch or division that deducts tax, or deduct centrally under one TAN, depending on how payments are made. We advise on the arrangement that suits your structure.
faqs.t: TDS Compliance for Businesses: Deduction, Deposit, Returns and Certificates Without the Stress

faqs.q: Can vendors claim TDS credit if our return has errors?
faqs.a: Not fully. Errors such as wrong PAN or challan details stop credits reaching the vendor’s Form 26AS until a correction statement is processed.
faqs.t: TDS Compliance for Businesses: Deduction, Deposit, Returns and Certificates Without the Stress

faqs.q: What is TDS?
faqs.a: Tax Deducted at Source: the payer deducts tax from certain payments, such as salaries, contractor and professional fees, and rent, and deposits it with the government on the payee’s behalf.
faqs.t: TDS Compliance for Businesses: Deduction, Deposit, Returns and Certificates Without the Stress

faqs.q: When is TDS due to be deposited?
faqs.a: For most deductions, typically by the 7th of the following month, with a longer period for March deductions. Confirm current due dates each year.
faqs.t: TDS Compliance for Businesses: Deduction, Deposit, Returns and Certificates Without the Stress

faqs.q: Which TDS returns do businesses file?
faqs.a: Commonly Form 24Q for salaries, Form 26Q for other payments to residents and Form 27Q for non-residents, filed quarterly. Forms may change under the new Income-tax Act.
faqs.t: TDS Compliance for Businesses: Deduction, Deposit, Returns and Certificates Without the Stress

faqs.q: What happens if TDS is not deducted or paid on time?
faqs.a: Interest applies for late deduction and late payment, fees apply for late returns, and expenses may be disallowed. Payees may also lose tax credits.
faqs.t: TDS Compliance for Businesses: Deduction, Deposit, Returns and Certificates Without the Stress

faqs.q: What is Form 16A?
faqs.a: A quarterly certificate issued to non-salary payees showing tax deducted and deposited, generated through TRACES after the return is processed.
faqs.t: TDS Compliance for Businesses: Deduction, Deposit, Returns and Certificates Without the Stress

faqs.q: How do we resolve a TDS default notice?
faqs.a: Review the TRACES justification report, compare with your books, then pay any amount genuinely due or file a correction statement where the default arises from data errors.
faqs.t: TDS Compliance for Businesses: Deduction, Deposit, Returns and Certificates Without the Stress

faqs.q: Do you handle TDS on payments to non-residents?
faqs.a: Yes, including review of applicable provisions and treaty benefits, documentation, and the related returns and certificates.
faqs.t: TDS Compliance for Businesses: Deduction, Deposit, Returns and Certificates Without the Stress

faqs.q: Can TDS be automated in our accounting software?
faqs.a: Yes. We configure vendor masters and TDS rules so tax is calculated automatically when bills are booked, then reconcile monthly.
faqs.t: TDS Compliance for Businesses: Deduction, Deposit, Returns and Certificates Without the Stress
